title: Small Business Support Grant Bondi Beach December 2025 – Privacy collection notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects, uses, and discloses your personal information when you apply for the Small Business Support Grant in Bondi Beach.
what_you_need: Name, date of birth, email address, and phone number
Details from a proof of identity document (such as a driver's licence or Australian passport)
Information about the business, including a valid ABN/ACN
Additional documentation and evidence as required in the Program Guidelines or to otherwise demonstrate eligibility

internal_links.text: Small Business Support Grant Bondi Beach December 2025

faqs.q: Why is Service NSW collecting my personal information?
faqs.a: The information is collected to process your application, determine your eligibility for the Grant, provide you with further information, and pay the Grant to eligible businesses.

faqs.q: What types of personal information will be collected?
faqs.a: Information collected includes your name, date of birth, email address, phone number, details from a proof of identity document (like a driver's licence or Australian passport), your business's ABN/ACN, banking details, and other required documentation.

faqs.q: How will my information be used and disclosed?
faqs.a: Your information may be used to contact you about your application, determine eligibility, process payments, invite you to participate in voluntary evaluation, and identify future government support grants you may be eligible for.
